note: Tempo's frame, included by music-player.screen.json: the top bar, Your Library, the Now Playing and queue panel, the player bar, full screen and the mini player, and the parts they share (cover tiles, track rows, toggles).

computed.libAll: {{concat([{ key: 'liked:0', kind: 'liked', i: 0, name: t('liked'), sub: t('lib.playlist') + ' · ' + t('lib.songs', { n: length(state.liked) }), type: 'playlists', by: 'Robin', n: 0, color: '#4527a0' }], map(state.saved, { key: 'playlist:' + it, kind: 'playlist', i: it, name: state.playlists[it].name, sub: t('lib.playlist') + ' · ' + state.playlists[it].owner, img: state.playlists[it].cover, type: 'playlists', color: state.playlists[it].color, by: state.playlists[it].owner, n: 10 + index }), map(state.following, { key: 'artist:' + it, kind: 'artist', i: it, name: state.artists[it].name, sub: t('lib.artist'), img: state.artists[it].image, round: true, type: 'artists', color: state.artists[it].color, by: state.artists[it].name, n: 40 + index }), map(state.savedAlbums, { key: 'album:' + it, kind: 'album', i: it, name: state.albums[it].title, sub: t('lib.album') + ' · ' + state.albums[it].artist, img: state.albums[it].cover, type: 'albums', color: state.albums[it].color, by: state.albums[it].artist, n: 70 + index }), map(state.savedShows, { key: 'show:' + it, kind: 'show', i: it, name: state.shows[it].name, sub: t('lib.podcast') + ' · ' + state.shows[it].publisher, img: state.shows[it].cover, type: 'podcasts', color: state.shows[it].color, by: state.shows[it].publisher, n: 90 + index }))}}
computed.libItems: {{sort(filter(computed.libAll, (state.lib.filter == '' || it.type == state.lib.filter) && (state.lib.query == '' || fuzzy(state.lib.query, it.name) != null)), (contains(state.pinned, it.key) ? '0' : '1') + (state.lib.sort == 'alpha' ? lower(it.name) : state.lib.sort == 'creator' ? lower(it.by) : state.lib.sort == 'added' ? pad(200 - it.n, 4) : pad(indexOf(state.recent, it.key) < 0 ? 500 + it.n : indexOf(state.recent, it.key), 4)))}}
computed.rows: {{state.view.page == 'playlist' ? state.playlists[state.view.i].tracks : state.view.page == 'liked' ? state.liked : state.view.page == 'album' ? filter(range(length(state.tracks)), state.tracks[it].al == state.view.i) : []}}
computed.shown: {{state.sort.by == '' ? computed.rows : sort(computed.rows, state.sort.by == 'title' ? lower(state.tracks[it].title) : state.sort.by == 'album' ? lower(state.tracks[it].album) : state.sort.by == 'added' ? pad(999 - indexOf(computed.rows, it), 4) : pad(state.tracks[it].d, 4), state.sort.desc ? 'desc' : 'asc')}}
computed.menuItems: {{state.menu.n < -1 ? computed.libMenu : [{ title: t('menu.queue'), icon: 'list-plus', run: 'addToQueue', with: { tracks: length(state.sel) > 1 ? map(state.sel, computed.shown[it]) : [state.menu.t] } }, { separator: true }, { title: t('menu.artist'), icon: 'user', run: 'go', with: { page: 'artist', i: computed.menuTrack.ar } }, { title: t('menu.album'), icon: 'disc-3', run: 'go', with: { page: 'album', i: computed.menuTrack.al } }, { separator: true }, { title: contains(state.liked, state.menu.t) ? t('menu.unlike') : t('menu.like'), icon: 'heart', run: 'like', with: { track: state.menu.t } }, { title: t('menu.addTo'), icon: 'plus', submenu: concat([{ title: t('menu.newPlaylist'), icon: 'circle-plus', run: 'createPlaylist', with: { tracks: [state.menu.t] } }, { separator: true }], map(computed.own, { title: state.playlists[it].name, run: 'addToPlaylist', with: { p: it, tracks: length(state.sel) > 1 ? map(state.sel, computed.shown[it]) : [state.menu.t] } })) }, { title: t('menu.remove'), icon: 'trash-2', enabled: state.view.page == 'playlist' && state.playlists[state.view.i].owner == 'Robin', run: 'removeFromPlaylist', with: { at: state.menu.n } }, { separator: true }, { title: t('menu.share'), icon: 'share-2', submenu: [{ title: t('menu.copyLink'), icon: 'link', run: 'copyLink', with: { name: computed.menuTrack.title } }, { title: t('menu.embed'), icon: 'code', run: 'copyLink', with: { name: computed.menuTrack.title } }] }]}}
computed.libMenu: {{[{ title: contains(state.pinned, state.menu.key) ? t('menu.unpin') : t('menu.pin'), icon: 'pin', run: 'pin', with: { key: state.menu.key } }, { title: t('menu.play'), icon: 'play', run: 'playItem', with: { kind: split(state.menu.key, ':')[0], i: number(split(state.menu.key, ':')[1]) } }, { separator: true }, { title: t('menu.removeLib'), icon: 'circle-minus', enabled: state.menu.key != 'liked:0', run: 'unsave', with: { key: state.menu.key } }]}}

pin.to: {{contains(state.pinned, key) ? filter(state.pinned, it != key) : concat([key], state.pinned)}}

save.note: with: kind, i. Adds a playlist, artist, album or show to Your Library, or takes it out

openMenu.note: with: t (a song), n (its row) and event: the song's menu where the pointer is

jumpQueue.note: with: at, a place in the songs after this one: it plays, and the ones before it are skipped

songRow.note: A song in the queue or the Now Playing panel: cover, title and artist; a click plays it
